title: Quick Ache Component Property Evidence
learningGoal: Experimentally compare pure sucrose, acetaminophen, and aspirin before designing a separation.

actions.label: Commit Team A and Team B hypotheses

parameters.prompt: State both consumer hypotheses before property evidence or unknown composition is revealed. Team B requires aspirin evidence.
parameters.note: Team A and Team B hypotheses recorded before any property test, so neither can be edited to fit the result.

interaction.accessibleLabel: Record evidence for Commit Team A and Team B hypotheses.

stateChanges: Commit Team A and Team B hypotheses evidence is recorded.

invalidCases.message: The separation plan has not been approved.
invalidCases.recovery: Submit the property evidence, chemical rationale, quantities, endpoints, and disposal plan for instructor approval.

feedback.success: Commit Team A and Team B hypotheses complete.
feedback.invalid: Record the required evidence and use the teacher-approved configuration before continuing.

invalidCases.recovery: Inspect the current labeled test portion.
